description: Trigger CostGuard Lambda every 5 minutes for budget monitoring and automated prevention

iamRole.description: IAM role for EventBridge to invoke CostGuard Lambda

freeTierCompliance.note: EventBridge rules are free. Invocations count toward Lambda free tier (1M requests/month)
freeTierCompliance.freeTierRemaining: Well within 1M Lambda invocations/month free tier

notes: Schedule runs every 5 minutes (12 times per hour)
EventBridge passes custom JSON input to Lambda to identify scheduled events
Lambda permission must be added to allow EventBridge to invoke the function
EventBridge role needs permission to invoke Lambda
Schedule can be disabled by setting state to DISABLED
Estimated 8,640 invocations/month well within Lambda free tier
